status: Second review completed: avoidable exemptions replaced with source improvements; the scoped scan has zero findings with 52 specific reviewed exceptions remaining.
implementationChanges: Gallery list and catalog RPC methods await image enumeration. The synchronous SDK method starts provider work independently of the calling synchronization context.

BackendHost and LocalImportApi support asynchronous disposal. Desktop Program awaits host disposal; listener shutdown does not capture the caller context. Synchronous compatibility disposal remains documented.
Linux dependency detection retains its public synchronous API while probing on a worker with a five-second cancellation limit. Cancellation follows the existing filesystem-probe path.

Folder import separates reflected fields, template fields and custom fields into typed records. JSON construction retains typed nodes, reflected attributes stay paired with their properties, and parsing validates required node shapes.

Folder import captures a validated Book/Project/Scenes/root scope and stores targets plus parser in one configuration value. Image storage retains the live book so changing its image folder remains supported.
Project, draft, image and export operations capture validated roots and models. The loaded-project predicate exposes its existing non-null invariants to nullable flow analysis.
Project-image import computes paths relative to the known image directory, including nested image folders. Narration cache writers retain their directory rather than reconstructing a nullable parent.
The iOS pan callback receives the recognizer directly. The file-access callback uses a typed result carrier, distinguishing a completed callback returning null/default from a callback that never ran.

Four internal narration APIs now accept cohesive direction, language, scene-settings and render contexts. Production and test callers use the typed contexts; SDK and JSON-RPC wire signatures are unchanged.
All 59 retained documentation exceptions were removed: 26 redundant summaries were deleted and 33 contracts were clarified. The earlier redundant VoiceDesignDto summary was also removed.
FolderImportService image handling lives in a responsibility-specific partial file. GrammarCheckService debug messages omit configured URLs that could contain userinfo or query credentials.

reviewedAnnotations.scope: Each comment names the exact rule and affected source line, with a specific reason. No global rule changes, file-wide first-party suppressions or configuration changes.
